mapper.sql: select cast(r.id as char) id,r.receipt_no receiptNo,cast(r.purchase_order_id as char) purchaseOrderId, o.order_no orderNo,w.name warehouse,u.display_name receiver,r.receipt_date receiptDate,r.remark, (select count(*) from inv_receipt_item i where i.receipt_id=r.id and i.deleted=0) itemCount from inv_receipt r join po_purchase_order o on o.id=r.purchase_order_id join md_warehouse w on w.id=r.warehouse_id join sys_user u on u.id=r.receiver_id
mapper.select: where r.deleted=0 order by r.id desc

select cast(r.id as char) id,r.receipt_no receiptNo,cast(r.purchase_order_id as char) purchaseOrderId, o.order_no orderNo,cast(r.warehouse_id as char) warehouseId,w.name warehouse, cast(r.receiver_id as char) receiverId,u.display_name receiver,r.receipt_date receiptDate,r.remark,r.created_at createdAt from inv_receipt r join po_purchase_order o on o.id=r.purchase_order_id join md_warehouse w on w.id=r.warehouse_id join sys_user u on u.id=r.receiver_id where r.id=#{id} and r.deleted=0

select cast(i.id as char) id,cast(i.order_item_id as char) purchaseOrderItemId, cast(i.material_id as char) materialId,m.code materialCode,m.name materialName, m.tracking_mode trackingMode,i.quantity,i.batch_no batchNo,i.serial_numbers_json serialNumbers from inv_receipt_item i join md_material m on m.id=i.material_id where i.receipt_id=#{id} and i.deleted=0 order by i.id
mapper.sql: select cast(b.id as char) id,w.name warehouse,m.code materialCode,m.name materialName, m.tracking_mode trackingMode,b.quantity,m.min_stock minStock,(b.quantity<m.min_stock) lowStock from inv_balance b join md_warehouse w on w.id=b.warehouse_id join md_material m on m.id=b.material_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from inv_balance b join md_warehouse w on w.id=b.warehouse_id join md_material m on m.id=b.material_id where b.deleted=0 and (m.code like #{like} or m.name like #{like} or w.name like #{like})
where b.deleted=0 and (m.code like #{like} or m.name like #{like} or w.name like #{like}) order by (b.quantity<m.min_stock) desc,m.code limit #{size} offset #{offset}
where b.deleted=0 order by lowStock desc,m.code
mapper.sql: select cast(l.id as char) id,w.name warehouse,m.code materialCode,m.name materialName, l.business_type businessType,cast(l.business_id as char) businessId,l.direction,l.quantity, l.balance_after balanceAfter,l.batch_no batchNo,l.created_at createdAt from inv_ledger l join md_warehouse w on w.id=l.warehouse_id join md_material m on m.id=l.material_id
mapper.select: where m.code like #{like} or m.name like #{like} order by l.id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
